meta_description:
60 likes, 2 comments - momspresso on June 4, 2023: "#repost @purnimamadaan Thanks for tagging us

One day at a time, mamma❤️#7monthspostpartum I know change is not that visible but I will not be too hard on myself!
I am super grateful to this body that has taken care of my angel for 9 months. At first, I was unable to accept it but now I am proud of it. Giving birth is no less than a miracle✨
Accept your #postpartumbelly gracefully❤️🫶🏻 And, pat yourself, you are doing amazingly great, new mamma😘

#Momspresso #mumfie #motherhood #postpartum #postpartumbody #postpartumfitness #health #delivery #csection

📌#Mumfie of the day. Share your mommy moments (Use the hashtag #Mumfie and don’t forget to tag us. We will repost our favourite)".
